content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-005 WildFire Known Bad ELF Download In Container) OR BIOC(CDR-005 WildFire ELF Execution In Container) OR BIOC(CDR-005 Downloaded Binary Executed By Service Account In Container) OR BIOC(CDR-005 Periodic Outbound HTTP Beacon From Container) OR BIOC(CDR-005 Post Execution C2 Network Activity In Container) OR BIOC(CDR-005 Mass File Modification Ransomware Pattern In Container) OR BIOC(CDR-005 Bulk Enc Extension Rename After Execution In Container) GROUPED BY container_id, causality_id WITHIN 300s
rules.name: WildFire Malware Kill Chain — Download Execute Beacon Encrypt
